I'm Alice, standing in the forest with Clara, Dex, and Finn. There's been some confusion about names - Clara keeps calling me "Eva" and insisting she's Alice, while I know I'm Alice. I've sent several messages trying to clarify this with Clara.

- I'm in the forest with lots of good herb spawns
- I have 201g and 2 Sunleaf in inventory
- There are excellent harvesting opportunities here

- Sunleaf with richness 5: 76278a39-14e, 8042a225-6cf, 8d09e2f0-63b, b4fbedfb-963
- Healroot with richness 4: 730411fe-f7f  
- Healroot with richness 3: 154ea559-ec7, 32cbcbd6-98a, 54a70f1f-9db

Since I have full turns and good spawns available, I should harvest while I can. The richness 5 Sunleaf spawns would be excellent targets, and the rich Healroot would diversify my herb collection nicely.

content.text:
*I glance around at the others, still puzzled by this whole name situation. Clara seems genuinely confused too, which is... odd. But I'm not going to waste perfectly good foraging time standing around debating identities when there are excellent herb spawns right here.*

Well, whatever's going on with the names can sort itself out. I've got prime foraging conditions and full energy - might as well make the most of it while these rich spawns are available.
